profiles.name: Anúbis
profiles.prompt: Rotate this SAME Anubis into STRICT 90-degree SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, like a side-scroller enemy. Entire head, torso, pelvis and feet face right, visible long jackal muzzle points right, one eye visible, NEVER frontal or three-quarter. Preserve jackal head, collar, kilt, staff and balance scale, separate the staff and scale so both read clearly. Full body height about 150px, center x=86 on 256x192 canvas; leave right half empty for attacks. Crisp same pixel art and colors, transparent.
profiles.refinement: Keep strict right-facing SIDE PROFILE of the same Anubis. Make BOTH weapons clearly visible: far hand holds the long upright black staff at x=160; near hand carries a GOLD BALANCE SCALE held forward at chest level, horizontal crossbar and TWO gold pans hanging from chains in front of waist. Do not hide scale behind body. Whole figure and weapons fully inside 256x192. Shift whole character to LEFT HALF, around x=75, with empty transparent space to the right. Same pixel style.
